deals.evidence: The Turkish businessman and TV personality Acun Ilicali completed his takeover of Hull
deals.headline: Acun Ilıcalı completes takeover of Hull City from the Allams
deals.summary: Turkish TV producer Acun Ilıcalı's Acun Medya group completed its purchase of the club, ending the Allam family's 11 years as owners; terms not disclosed. Companies House shows Ilıcalı as controller (75% or more) from 2 February 2022.

deals.summary: After the 2024/25 year end the club converted loan balances into equity, issuing one ordinary share at nominal value with a share premium of €16,753,624.

name: Hull City Association Football Club
notes: League corrected to Premier League: Hull won the 2025/26 Championship play-off final against Middlesbrough (premierleague.com). Revenue and P&L from Hull City Tigers Limited accounts for the year to 30 June 2025 (iXBRL version cited). Revenue breakdown: matchday is the 'Attendance' line only; 'Other match day' (£2,094,269) and 'Retail' (£2,351,978) are separate lines left out rather than summed. Net debt includes loans from group undertakings (£57,386,950) and other loans from ACM BV Group and Allamhouse; the Allamhouse loan is 'non-repayable unless promoted to Premier League', which happened in May 2026. Stadium: the accounts say the stadium is leased from a related party (Superstadium Management Company); no citable page found stating the freehold owner, so stadium_owner is null. Lender amounts (Macquarie, Point72) are not in the filings. Shirt sponsor (Corendon Airlines per the club site), chair and chief executive are only on the club's JavaScript site, which cannot be read as text. Companies House also shows share allotments on 18 August 2025 and 15, 22 and 26 January 2026 (scanned SH01 forms, amounts not read). No valuation, attendance or social counts found.

owners.evidence: The company is ultimately controlled by Ali Acun Ilicali.
owners.name: Acun Ilıcalı (via Acun Medya Holding BV)

ownership_summary: Owned by Turkish TV producer Acun Ilıcalı through his Dutch holding company Acun Medya Holding BV, which completed its purchase of the club from the Allam family on 19 January 2022. Companies House lists Ilıcalı as the only person with significant control (75% or more); the club funds itself with owner loans and, since 2025-26, secured lending from Macquarie Bank and Point72 UK Lending.
revenue_source_name: Hull City Tigers Limited annual report and financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (Companies House)
stadium_capacity_evidence: Hull City share the 24,983-capacity stadium with rugby league club Hull F.C.
